set -e
echo "[redeploy] start $(date +%s)"
mkdir -p /home/ubuntu/agent-shell
echo '[provision] refreshing agent-shell'"'"'s compose file and .env.defaults from dev'
<helper:provision> 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuesslerm/mobile-learning-app/dev/infra/oracle-cloud/agent-shell/docker-compose.prod.yml' '/home/ubuntu/agent-shell/docker-compose.prod.yml' 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuesslerm/mobile-learning-app/dev/infra/oracle-cloud/agent-shell/.env.defaults' '/home/ubuntu/agent-shell/.env.defaults' 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuesslerm/mobile-learning-app/dev/infra/oracle-cloud/dind.yml' '/home/ubuntu/agent-shell/../dind.yml'
echo "[redeploy] provisioned $(date +%s)"
if [ ! -f /home/ubuntu/agent-shell/.env.local ] && [ -f /home/ubuntu/vm-ops-api/.env.local ]; then cp /home/ubuntu/vm-ops-api/.env.local /home/ubuntu/agent-shell/.env.local; fi
if [ -f /home/ubuntu/agent-shell/.env.local ]; then grep -E '^(BWS_[A-Z0-9_]+|SECRETS_BACKEND)=' /home/ubuntu/agent-shell/.env.local > /home/ubuntu/agent-shell/.env.bootstrap || true; if sh -n /home/ubuntu/agent-shell/.env.bootstrap; then set -a; . /home/ubuntu/agent-shell/.env.bootstrap; set +a; rm -f /home/ubuntu/agent-shell/.env.bootstrap; else rm -f /home/ubuntu/agent-shell/.env.bootstrap; echo '[env] .env.local has a BWS_ or SECRETS_BACKEND line that does not parse' >&2; false; fi; fi
unset BETTERSTACK_OTLP_TOKEN BETTERSTACK_OTLP_HOST EXPO_PUBLIC_BETTERSTACK_TOKEN
( cd /home/ubuntu/agent-shell && wf secret sync-env --for agent-shell --backend bitwarden --base .env.defaults --out .env )
cp /home/ubuntu/agent-shell/.env /home/ubuntu/agent-shell/.env.synced
echo "HOST_LABEL=main" >> /home/ubuntu/agent-shell/.env
<helper:appendEnvLocal> /home/ubuntu/agent-shell/.env /home/ubuntu/agent-shell/.env.local
<helper:verifyEnv> /home/ubuntu/agent-shell/.env.synced /home/ubuntu/agent-shell/.env
echo "[redeploy] env synced $(date +%s)"
flock -s /home/ubuntu/vm-ops-api sh -c 'cd /home/ubuntu/agent-shell && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml pull app'
echo "[redeploy] pulled $(date +%s)"
docker volume create agent-workspace >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ; docker volume create clis >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ; cd /home/ubuntu/agent-shell && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --no-deps $(docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml config --services | grep -vxE 'app|agent-sessions|agent-dind|agent-droid') ; docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --no-deps --no-recreate agent-sessions agent-dind agent-droid ; docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --no-deps app
if cp -p /home/ubuntu/agent-shell/.env /home/ubuntu/agent-shell/.env.tmp && echo "IMAGE_TAG=latest" >> /home/ubuntu/agent-shell/.env.tmp && mv -f /home/ubuntu/agent-shell/.env.tmp /home/ubuntu/agent-shell/.env; then :; else rm -f /home/ubuntu/agent-shell/.env.tmp; false; fi
echo "[redeploy] compose done $(date +%s)"
flock -x /home/ubuntu/vm-ops-api sh -c '[ "$(df --output=pcent / | tail -1 | tr -dc 0-9)" -lt 70 ] || { docker image prune -af --filter until=1h; docker builder prune -f --keep-storage 6GB; docker container prune -f --filter until=1h; }' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
